blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Psycholinguistic studies explore why humans accept some generic statements but reject others by showing that these judgments depend on more than how common a property is. People consider several other factors such as how well it sets the kind apart from others or whether it is characteristic of the kind.
  Inspired by the linguistic and cognitive literature, we explore to what extent factors from these studies explain how large language models (LLMs) judge generics. Our results with twelve models on a psycholinguistic dataset and on naturally occurring generics show that models weigh how common a property is against how well it distinguishes the kind, and combine the two much as people do, though less clearly. Like people, they favor characteristic properties, but unlike the accounts of human judgment, they ignore striking ones. What matters most to LLMs is whether a statement is factually true, and much of the influence of human factors reaches their ratings through that judgment. In six 7-9B models, shifting the hidden states along each factor's direction moves the judgment as the factor predicts.
blocks.zh:
心理语言学研究探讨了人类为什么接受一些一般说法,却拒绝其他说法,其方法是表明这些判断所依赖的不仅仅是财产的共性. 人们会考虑其他几个因素,例如它如何将这种类型与其他人区分开来,或者它是否具有这种特征。
在语言和认知文献的启发下,我们探索了这些研究中的各种因素在多大程度上解释了大语言模型(LLMs)如何判断通用语言. 我们用十二个模型对一个心理语言数据集 和自然产生的通用数据 的结果显示,模型权衡一个财产的共性 与它如何区分这种类型, 并和人们一样将两者结合起来, 虽然不太清楚。 和人一样,他们偏爱特征属性,但与人类判断的叙述不同,他们忽略了惊人的属性. LLMs最要紧的是,声明是否属实,人类因素的许多影响通过这一判断达到其评级. 在6个7-9B模型中,沿每个因子方向移动隐藏状态会使判断作为因子预测.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
People readily accept “Lions have manes” but not “Lions are male,” even though the latter is true of more lions than the former. This contrast suggests that judgments about generic statements, which concern types rather than individuals, cannot be explained simply by the frequency of a property or the number of individuals for which a statement is true ( Leslie, 2008 ; Prasada et al., 2013 ) . Instead, these judgments reflect how people represent categories. Generics have been argued to express the mind’s default mode of generalization ( Leslie, 2008 ) . People accept them on little evidence, particularly when the property is dangerous ( Cimpian et al., 2010 ) , treat properties that are principled consequences of being a kind differently from merely common ones ( Prasada et al., 2013 ) , and even extend characteristic generics to universal claims such as “All ducks lay eggs” ( Leslie et al., 2011 ) . Ryu et al. (2022) showed that the acceptability of generics depends on two interacting factors: prevalence , or how common a property is within a kind, and cue validity , or how strongly that property distinguishes the kind from relevant alternatives. Other accounts of how people judge generics (e.g. Hoorens et al. (2026) ; Hermans et al. (2026) ) treat people as intuitive statisticians who weigh how common a property is in the kind against how common it is in alternative
kinds: a highly diagnostic property can support a generic statement even when it is relatively uncommon within the kind. Having a mane distinguishes lions from other animals, whereas being male does not.

blocks.zh: 图1:我们探讨与心理语言学文献相比,各种因素在多大程度上解释了一般语的LLM判断,这些模型所指的其他因素,以及这些因素能否引导模型内的可接受性。

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as proxies for human judgments and as models of human language processing ( Binz and Schulz, 2023 ; Dillion et al., 2023 ) . Their agreement with human judgments, however, does not establish that models arrive at those judgments in the same way as people. Generics have long posed a challenge for theories of language acquisition: although their truth conditions are difficult to specify, children understand them at an early age and with little explicit evidence ( Leslie, 2008 ) . LLMs offer a useful comparison because they learn from text, in which generics are common. Previous work on generics in LLMs has examined whether models overgeneralize or accept the same statements as humans ( Ralethe and Buys, 2022 ) , as well as how generics relate to quantified statements ( Cilleruelo et al., 2025 ) . It remains unclear, however, whether models rely on the same factors that shape human judgments . We thus ask the following questions: • To what extent can LLM acceptability be explained by factors used in human psycholinguistic studies; • What additional factors the models themselves point to when explaining their judgments, and how they relate to the psychological ones; • Whether shifting the models’ internal states along each factor’s direction changes their judgments as the factor predicts.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地被用作人类判断的代词和人类语言处理的模型(Binz and Schulz, 2023年;Dillion等人, 2023年). 然而,他们同意人类的判断,并不能证明模型与人一样得出这些判断。 通用语言长期以来对语言获取理论提出了挑战:尽管其真实性条件难以具体确定,但儿童在年幼时就了解这些理论,而且没有明确的证据(Leslie,2008年)。 LLMs提供了一个有用的比较,因为它们从文本中学习,在文本中通用. 以前关于LLMs中通用词的工作审查了模型是否过度概括或接受与人类相同的语句(Ralethe and Buys,2022),以及通用词与量化语句的关系(Cilleruelo等人,2025年). 然而,尚不清楚模型是否依赖影响人类判断的相同因素。 因此,我们提出下列问题: LLM的可接受性在多大程度上可以用人类心理语言学研究中所使用的因素来解释; 模型本身在解释其判断时指出的其他什么因素,以及它们与心理判断的关系; 沿着每个因素的方向转移模型的内部状态是否改变其判断力作为因素的预测.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: What makes generic statements acceptable has long been a central question for linguists. Leslie (2008) argued that people’s acceptance of generics depends on more than prevalence, or how common a property is within a kind. Ryu et al. (2022) further showed that acceptance also depends on cue validity, or how strongly a property predicts kind membership, while Hoorens et al. (2026) and Hermans et al. (2026) highlighted the role of relative prevalence, showing that acceptance depends on how common a property is in one kind compared with others. However, people’s judgments reflect more than statistical patterns. Characteristic properties are judged differently from merely common ones ( Prasada et al., 2013 ) , sometimes supporting universal claims such as All ducks lay eggs ( Leslie et al., 2011 ) . Similarly, Leslie (2008) argued that striking properties require little evidence to support a generic, and Cimpian et al. (2010) showed that dangerous properties are accepted at lower prevalence levels, although this effect seems to be limited to intermediate prevalence ( Hermans et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 使一般性声明可以接受,长期以来是语言学家的核心问题。 Leslie (2008年)认为,人们是否接受非专利,不仅取决于流行程度,还取决于财产在某种财产中的共同程度。 龙等. (2022年)进一步显示,接受还取决于提示有效性,或一个财产如何强烈地预测善良的会籍,而Hoorens等人(2026年)和Hermans等人. (2026年)强调了相对普遍的作用,表明接受取决于一种财产与另一种财产相比的共性。 然而,人们的判断不仅仅反映统计模式。 特征特性与普通特性不同(Prasada等人,2013年),有时支持普遍主张,如All Ducks产卵(Leslie等人,2011年)。 同样,Leslie (2008年)认为,打击性能几乎不需要证据来证明通用性,Cimpian等人(2010年)表明,危险性能在流行率较低时被接受,尽管这种影响似乎仅限于中间流行率(Hermans等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Research on language models has also engaged with generics. Ralethe and Buys (2022) and Allaway et al. (2024) found that models overgeneralize from generics to universal claims and struggle with exceptions. Although models show human-like nonmonotonic reasoning when given exceptions, their judgments often shift when unrelated or even supporting examples are added ( Leidinger et al., 2024 ) . In how they judge generics, Peters et al. (2026) found that LLMs rate scientific generics as more generalizable and credible than people and Hu et al. (2024) showed that they largely fail to distinguish principled from statistical properties once prevalence is controlled. These studies leave open the issue of which factors shape models’ judgments and whether they resemble those underlying human judgments.
blocks.zh: 关于语言模型的研究也与通用语言有关。 Ralethe and Buys(2022年)和Allaway等人(2024年)发现模型过于概括,从通用到普遍主张,并有例外地挣扎. 虽然模型在给定例外时显示出类似人类的非模棱两可的推理,但当添加不相关的甚至支持性的例子时,其判断往往会转变(Leidinger等人,2024年). 彼得斯等人(2026年)在他们如何判断通用词时发现,LLMS将科学通用词评为比人和胡等人更笼统,更可信. (2024年)表明,一旦流行率得到控制,它们基本上无法区分原则性和统计性。 这些研究留下了一个问题,即哪些因素决定了模型的判断,它们是否与人类的判断相似。

blocks.en: A second line of work infers model judgments from probabilities rather than written answers. Direct probability measures can reveal knowledge that metalinguistic prompts miss ( Hu and Levy, 2023 ; Kauf et al., 2024 ) and have long been used to model acceptability ( Lau et al., 2017 ) . For generics, Cilleruelo et al. (2025) introduced ConGen, using surprisal to estimate their implicit quantifiers; Calderón et al. (2026) later argued that no single quantifier preserves a generic’s meaning. However, neither study examines the factors shaping human acceptance. We use surprisal to test whether models reflect these factors and compare their written answers with their expected ratings.
blocks.zh: 第二行工作从概率而非书面答复推断出模型判断. 直接概率度量可以揭示出金属inguistic诱发误差的知识(Hu and Levy, 2023; Kauf 等人, 2024 ),并长期用于模型可接受性(Lau等人, 2017 ). Cilleruelo et al. (2025年)对通用词提出了ConGen, 利用优势来估计其隐含的修饰词; Calderón et al. (2026年)后来认为,没有一个修饰词保留通用词的含义. 然而,这两项研究都没有研究影响人类接受的因素。 我们使用超额测试模型是否反映了这些因素,并将其书面答复与预期的评级进行比较.

blocks.en: Even when models agree with humans, how they reach their judgments remains unclear. Interpretability research shows that numeric attributes are encoded along linear directions that can shift model outputs when manipulated ( Heinzerling and Inui, 2024 ) , and that similar interventions can flip truth judgments across datasets ( Marks and Tegmark, 2024 ) . Building on El-Shangiti et al. (2025) , we test whether intervening along directions associated with individual factors shifts model ratings.
blocks.zh: 即使模型与人类一致,他们如何做出判断仍然不明确. 解释性研究表明,数字属性按照线性方向编码,在被操纵时可以改变模型输出(Heinzerling and Inui, 2024),类似的干预可以翻转真实判断跨数据集(Marks and Tegmark, 2024). 在El-Shangiti等人(2025年)的基础上,我们检验是否按照个别因素变化模型评级的相关方向进行干预。

blocks.en: 3 Statistical accounts of acceptability
blocks.zh: 3 可接受性统计核算

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental design
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设计

blocks.en:
We first investigate whether LLMs rely on the same information as people when judging generics, and whether they combine it in the same way. Building on statistical accounts of generic acceptability ( Ryu et al., 2022 ; Hoorens et al., 2026 ) , we base our experimental design on Ryu et al. (2022) , in which participants rated each generic on two factors. Prevalence is how common people expect a property to be within a kind. For “Ducks lay eggs,”
participants were asked “Suppose you encounter a duck X. How likely is it that X lays eggs?”. Ratings range from 0 to 100; where they label the ends 0 ( definitely not ) and 100 ( definitely yes ). Cue validity is how likely something with the property is to belong to the kind, among members of a broader comparison (superordinate) category. Using birds as the
comparison category, participants were asked, “Suppose a bird X lays eggs. How likely is it that X is a duck?” Ratings range from − 3 -3 ( very unlikely ) to + 3 +3 ( very likely ).
A separate group of participants rated acceptability, from − 3 -3 ( definitely reject ) to + 3 +3 ( definitely accept ).

blocks.en: For our experiment, we prompted each model to rate every item for acceptability, prevalence and cue validity with the same question template and scales they used (full prompts in Appendix A ). We then applied the same analyses to each model’s ratings: the correlation between prevalence and cue validity; for IS_A generics, the correlations of acceptability with each factor; for feature-describing generics, the regression of acceptability on prevalence, cue validity and their interaction; and the same correlations within the high- and low-cue-validity groups.

blocks.en: 3.2 Data
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据

blocks.en: Our first dataset contains the 84 generics used by Ryu et al. (2022) , drawn from Prasada et al. (2013) : 20 IS_A and 64 feature-describing generics. Of the latter, 30 have high cue validity (above 1.3) and 34 have lower cue validity. The published mean ratings of acceptability, prevalence and cue validity serve as our human reference, which makes this the dataset on which model and human judgments can be compared directly. They obtained more general comparison categories for cue validity from human participants but did not publish a complete list, so we supplied one for each item using the procedure described for ConGen in Appendix B . Ours match the examples in their paper, such as “a bird” for “Ducks lay eggs”and “a toy” for “Dolls wear dresses.”
blocks.zh: 我们的第一个数据集包含Ryu等人(2022年)使用的84个通用词,取自Prasada等人(2013年):20个IS_A和64个特征描述通用词. 在后者中,30项具有高提示有效性(高于1.3),34项具有较低提示有效性。 所公布的可接受性、普遍性和提示有效性的平均评级可作为我们人类的参考,这使数据集能够直接比较模型和人类判断。 他们从人类参与者那里获得了更多关于提示有效性的比较类,但没有公布完整的清单,因此我们使用附录B中ConGen描述的程序,为每个项目提供了一份清单。 我们与论文中的例子一致,例如“Ducks产卵”的“一只鸟”和“Dolls穿裙子”的“玩具”。 “

blocks.en: To test our findings on naturally occurring generics, we constructed a second dataset from the 970 bare generics in ConGen ( Cilleruelo et al., 2025 ) . We automatically extracted category and property phrases and assigned comparison categories for the cue-validity questions. An LLM judge checked the conversions, with flagged items reviewed manually. Two annotators reviewed the comparison categories, and a third resolved disagreements (see Appendix B for details). The final dataset contains 732 items: 582 feature-describing and 150 IS_A generics. Since human acceptability ratings are unavailable for ConGen, we test whether each model’s ratings follow the pattern predicted by Ryu et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh: 为了测试我们关于自然产生的通用软件的调查结果,我们在ConGen(Cilleruelo等人,2025年)从970个光学通用软件中建造了第二个数据集。 我们自动提取类词和属性词组 并指定比较类, 用于提示有效性问题 。 一名LLM法官检查了转换情况,对标有标记的物品进行了人工审查。 2名注释员审查了比较类别,1名注释员解决了分歧(详见附录B)。 最终数据集包含732个项目:582个特征描述和150个IS_A通用. 由于ConGen没有人类的可接受性评级,我们检验每个模型的评级是否遵循了Ryu等人(2022年)预测的模式。

blocks.en: 3.3 Models
blocks.zh: 3.3 模式

blocks.en: Our main analyses use six open-weight instruction-tuned language models with 7–9B parameters: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) , Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) , OLMo-3-7B-Instruct ( Team Olmo et al., 2025 ) , Gemma-2-9B-it ( Gemma Team et al., 2024 ) and Qwen3-8B ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) , the latter with disabled reasoning mode, to keep the task closer to the original one for humans. To test whether the results generalize, we study two further groups of models. The first contains four larger models that, like the open models above, answer directly: Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) and Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) , larger versions of two of those models, so that size is the main difference; and two proprietary models of undisclosed size, GPT-4.1 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) and Gemini-2.5-Flash ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) , the latter with reasoning switched off. The second contains two reasoning models, Gemini-3.8-Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) and Qwen3.8-Flash ( Qiu et al., 2026 ) , a mixture-of-experts model with 125B parameters (6B active per token).
blocks.zh: 我们的主要分析使用6个开放量级的教学调试语言模型,其中7 -9B参数: Quen2.5-7B-Instruct(Quen等人,2025年),Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct(Grattafiori等人,2024年),Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3(Jiang等人,2023年),OLMo-3-B-Instruct(Team Olmo等人,2025年),Gemma-2-9B-it(Gemma Team等人,2024年)和Quen3-8B(Quen Team,2025年),后者具有残疾推理模式,为人类保持与原任务接近. 为了检验结果是否通用,我们研究了另外两类模型。 第一个包含四个更大的模型,与上面的开放模型一样,直接回答: Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct(Grattafiori等人,2024年)和Quen2.5-72B-Instruct(Quen等人,2025年),其中两种型号的较大版本,因此大小是主要区别;两种未披露大小的专有型号GPT-4.1(OpenAI,2025年)和双子2.5-Flash(Comanici等人,2025年),后者的推理关闭. 其二包含双子座-3.8-Flash(Google DeepMind,2026年)和Qune3.8-Flash(Quiu等人,2026年)两种推理模型,是一种具有125B参数的专家混合模型(6B active per acident).

blocks.en: We ran each analysis with two sets of predictors. First, we used each model’s own prevalence and cue-validity ratings to test whether its acceptability judgments follow the human pattern given its own estimates of these factors. Each model, however, provides a single integer rating per item, whereas human ratings are averaged across participants. Noise in individual ratings may therefore obscure the interaction even when a model combines the factors as people do. To reduce this source of noise, we repeated the analyses using human ratings for Ryu et al.’s items and, for ConGen, ratings averaged within each model’s group (7–9B, larger direct-answer or reasoning models). On Ryu et al.’s items, these group averages correlate closely with human ratings ( r = .79 r=.79 – .87 .87 for prevalence and r = .73 r=.73 – .75 .75 for cue validity; cr. Table 3 in the Appendix for details). We assess whether model judgments follow the human pattern using either the model’s own estimates or estimates averaged across participants or models.
blocks.zh: 我们用两组预测器来分析 首先,我们利用每个模型本身的流行程度和准效评级来测试其可接受性判断是否遵循了人类模式,因为其自身对这些因素的估计。 然而,每个模型都提供每个项目的单一整数评级,而人类的评级则在参与者中平均。 因此,个人评级中的噪声可能掩盖互动,即使一个模型将各种因素结合到人身上。 为了减少这种噪音的来源,我们重复了使用人类对隆等人物品的评级进行分析,对康根来说,是每个模型组(7-9B,较大的直接回答或推理模型)的平均评级。 在隆等人的项目上,这些组别与人类的评分(r = 79 r = 79 = 87 = 87,r = 73 r = 73 = 75 = 75)的平均值密切相关;详细情况请参见附录表3。 我们利用模型自己的估计数或参与者或模型的平均数来评估模型判断是否遵循人的模式。

blocks.en: For IS_A generics, Ryu et al. (2022) found that acceptability increases with prevalence and decreases with cue validity, while the two factors are negatively correlated. All twelve models reproduce the positive relationship between acceptability and their own prevalence ratings on Ryu et al.’s items, while eleven show a negative correlation between prevalence and cue validity. On ConGen, however, prevalence and cue validity are positively correlated for all but the reasoning models. The relationship between prevalence and acceptability is also weaker for all twelve models. We analyze the reason for the positive correlation between the two factors for ConGen and find that it is mainly a reflection of the difference in dataset construction. Ryu et al.’s items pair a kind with a broader category ( Dogs are mammals : high prevalence, low cue validity) or reverse that relation ( Mammals are dogs : low prevalence, high cue validity), placing the factors in opposition by design. ConGen contains few reversed statements and many definitional ones, whose properties are both common within the kind and diagnostic of it.
blocks.zh: 对于IS_A类人,Ryu等人(2022年)认为,可接受性随着流行程度的提高而降低,而这两个因素是消极关联的。 所有十二种模式都照搬了龙等人物品的可接受性和自身流行率评级之间的正相关关系,而十一种模式则显示出流行率与提示有效性之间的负相关关系。 然而,在ConGen上,除推理模型外,普遍性和提示有效性对所有人都是正相关联的。 对所有十二种模式而言,流行程度和可接受程度之间的关系也较弱。 我们分析ConGen这两个因素之间正相关的原因,发现这主要反映了数据集构建的差异. Ryu等人的物品与更广泛的类别(狗为哺乳动物:高流行率,低提示有效性)配对,或扭转这种关系(哺乳动物为狗:低流行率,高提示有效性),通过设计将因素置于对立位置。 ConGen中很少包含倒置语句和许多定义语句,其属性在类型和诊断语中都是常见的.

blocks.en:
The weaker relationship between prevalence and acceptability appears to reflect uncertainty about prevalence. Models agree closely on prevalence for Ryu et al.’s items (mean inter-model r = .92 r=.92 ; correlation between their average and human ratings: r = .98 r=.98 ), but less so for ConGen ( r = .57 r=.57 ). ConGen includes negations ( Raspberries are not bushes ) and technical descriptions ( Rabbits are hind gut fermenters ) that may make prevalence harder to assess. We take half of ConGen’s items with greater agreement among models and find that the correlations between prevalence and acceptability exceed those on the full set for all twelve models, hence suggesting that models rely on prevalence more strongly whenever the prevalence of a property can be clearly assessed. Figure 2 shows the relationship between prevalence and acceptability for one Qwen
model from each group, while Appendix C.2 reports both correlations for all models. We return to this pattern in § 4 , where we examine whether prevalence predicts acceptability because it tracks factuality.

blocks.en: For feature-describing generics, Ryu et al. (2022) found that people weigh prevalence and cue validity against each other. Both make a generic more acceptable, but the higher the cue validity, the less the prevalence matters. Models are sensitive to both factors and follow the human pattern in both datasets. On ConGen, prevalence and cue validity both predict acceptability in nearly all models. On Ryu et al.’s items, both factors again predict acceptability, more strongly with the human ratings of the two factors than with the models’ own, but the interaction is weak: it usually points in the human direction but is rarely significant for individual models. Averaged ratings, whether from people or models show the human pattern clearly.
blocks.zh: 对于特征描述的通用词,Ryu等人(2022年)发现,人们相互权衡流行率和提示有效性。 两者都使通用性更容易被接受,但提示有效性越高,流行性问题就越少. 模型对这两个因素都敏感,并遵循两个数据集中的人类模式. 在ConGen上,普遍性和提示有效性都预示着几乎所有模型的可接受性。 在隆等人的项目上,这两个因素再次预测了可接受性,与模型本身相比,人类对这两个因素的评级更为强烈,但相互作用很弱:通常指向人类方向,但对单个模型却很少重要. 平均收视率,无论是从人还是模型来看,都清楚地显示了人的模式.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 illustrates this for Qwen3-8B, and the same pattern recurs across models (Appendix C.3 ). As for humans, cue validity matters most when prevalence is low, and its effect weakens as prevalence increases. The interaction is clearer in the larger models, and averaging ratings across models brings it out in the smaller ones as well; with group-averaged ratings on ConGen, most models combine the two factors significantly in the same way as
humans. Overall, the models apply the human rule in its direction, and the larger ones come close to its strength. The interaction is about as strong on Ryu et al.’s items as on ConGen, but with nine times as many items, it reaches significance for many more models on ConGen, suggesting that its weakness on Ryu et
al.’s items is due to the small sample size.

blocks.en: 4 Beyond prevalence and cue validity
blocks.zh: 页:1 超越流行和提示有效性

blocks.en: Prevalence and cue validity explain only part of the variance in acceptability ratings (55% of the variance in people’s ratings and 3–42% in each model’s own ratings on Ryu et al.’s feature-describing items). We therefore examined four further factors that might account for how models judge generics.
blocks.zh: 普遍度和提示有效性只是部分可接受性评级差异的原因(人们的评级差异的55%,以及每个模型在Ryu等人的特征描述项目上自己的评级的3-42%)。 因此,我们审查了其他四个因素,这些因素可能说明模型如何判断通用词。

blocks.en: In the psychology of generics, two further factors explain judgments that prevalence cannot. Some generics are rejected although almost every member has the property, as in Humans are over three years old . Prasada et al. (2013) account for this with characteristicness : a generic is accepted when the property is characteristic of the kind itself, not merely common among its members. Other generics are accepted although only a few members have the property, as in Mosquitoes carry malaria . Leslie (2008) and Cimpian et al. (2010) attribute this to strikingness : a dangerous or otherwise remarkable property licenses a generic on little evidence. Thus, both are candidates to be additional factors shaping the ratings of the models.
blocks.zh: 在一般人的心理学中,还有两个因素可以解释普遍性不能存在的判断. 虽然几乎每个成员都有财产, 普拉萨达等人(2013年)对此有其特点: 当财产是这种财产本身的特征,而不仅仅是其成员之间的共同特征时,即为接受。 虽然只有少数成员拥有这种财产,但其他通用财产被接受,如蚊虫携带疟疾。 Leslie(2008年)和Cimpian等人(2010年)将此归因于惊人性:一种危险或引人注目的财产许可证几乎是通用财产。 因此,这两个候选人都是影响模型评级的其他因素。

blocks.en: The second source is the models themselves. To see whether they attend to considerations that the accounts of human judgment leave out, we asked each 7–9B model to explain its reasoning before rating Ryu et al.’s items, and compared the words in explanations that ended in rejection with those that ended in acceptance (Appendix D.1 ). Two kinds of consideration stood out. Explanations ending in acceptance appealed to whether the statement is factually correct, and those ending in rejection objected that it is inaccurate or overgeneralizes, applying to more members than it should. We therefore added two new factors: factuality , the model’s judgment of whether the statement is accurate; and overreach , its judgment of whether the statement claims more than is warranted. Overreach connects to two earlier findings: people tend to accept universal claims such as All ducks lay eggs when the corresponding generic is true ( Leslie et al., 2011 ) , and language models overgeneralize from generics in a similar way ( Allaway et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 第二个来源是模型本身. 为了了解他们是否考虑人类判断所忽略的考虑,我们要求每个7-9B模型在对Ryou et al.项目进行评分之前解释其推理,并将最后被否定的解释中的词语与最终被接受的词语进行比较(附录D.1 )。 两种考虑非常突出。 以接受方式结束的解释对声明事实上是否正确提出了质疑,以拒绝方式结束的解释则表示反对,认为声明不准确或过于笼统,适用于更多的成员,而不应如此。 因此,我们增加了两个新因素:事实性,模型对声明是否准确的判断;以及过度触及,模型对声明是否声称超出正当性的判断。 过度普及与之前的两个发现相关联:人们倾向于接受普遍诉求,如当对应的通用性属实时,All Ducks产卵(Leslie等人,2011年),语言模型以类似方式从通用性中过度概括(Allaway等人,2024年).

blocks.en: Each model rated every ConGen and Ryu et al.’s item on the four factors, with questions built like those for prevalence and cue validity (Appendix A ). We test the factors separately for IS_A and feature-describing generics, since Ryu et al. (2022) found different rules for the two on humans. To test what the new factors contribute, we needed a baseline built from the two established ones. We use A ∼ P + C A\sim P+C as the baseline for both types, since adding their interaction rarely improves held-out predictions (Appendix D.2 ).
blocks.zh: 每个模型对每个ConGen和Ryu等人在四个因素上的物品进行评分,所构建的问题与流行和提示有效性的问题类似(附录A)。 我们分别测试IS_A和特征描述的通用词,自隆等人以来. (2022年)为两人在人类身上发现了不同的规则. 为了检验新因素的作用,我们需要从两个既定因素中建立基线。 我们使用A + C A\sim P+C作为这两种类型的基准,因为添加它们的相互作用很少能改进搁置的预测(附录D.2)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Factors from the psychology of generics
blocks.zh: 4.1 一般人心理学中的因素

blocks.en: We first test whether either factor restates prevalence or cue validity. Across the twelve models and both datasets, no correlation of characteristicness or strikingness with a model’s prevalence or cue validity exceeds .63 in absolute value. Both relate to prevalence in the direction the psychological accounts predict. Characteristicness rises with prevalence in every model and dataset and strikingness falls with it in all but one case (Appendix D.3 ; Figure 6 ). The characteristicness ratings also capture what this factor describes. Ryu et al.’s items come from Prasada et al. (2013) , who sorted them into seven types, separating properties that are part of what the kind is ( Ducks lay eggs ) from ones that are merely common ( Cars have radios ) or striking ( Mosquitoes carry malaria ). Every model rates the first group as more characteristic, and the models’ ranking of the seven types follows people’s judgments in Prasada et al. ’s study (Appendix D.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先要检验的是任一因素是否重复流行性还是提示有效性。 在12个模型和两个数据集中,特征或震撼度与模型的流行度或提示有效性的关联性在绝对值上都没有超过.63。 两者都与心理学预测的流行率有关。 特征随每个模型和数据集的流行程度而上升,除一个案例外,所有案例的流行程度也随之下降(附录D.3;图6)。 特征评级也捕捉到这个因素所描述的. Ryu等人的物品来自Prasada等人(2013年),他们将物品分为七类,将属于这种物品(鸭子产卵)的特性与单纯常见的(汽车有收音机)或打击(蚊子携带疟疾)的特性分开。 每个模型都认为第一组更具有特征,模型对这七类的排名遵循普拉萨达等人的判断. 研究(附录D.4).

blocks.en: Within each generic type, we add both factors to the baseline and standardise all ratings, so that each factor is credited only with what it explains beyond the others, then compare how much of the variance the model explains with and without them.
blocks.zh: 在每一种通用类型中,我们都会在基线中增加两个因素,并使所有评级标准化,这样,每个因素只计入它所解释的超出其他因素的部分,然后比较模型所解释的和没有这些差异的多少。

blocks.en: Characteristicness raises acceptability in almost every model, for both types of generic (Figure 4 ). Its effect is largest where the baseline does worst. On Ryu et al.’s feature-describing items, prevalence and cue validity explain little of the ratings of most larger and reasoning models (3–24% of the variance, against 55% of people’s), but with characteristicness and strikingness added they explain 33–50%. On ConGen the effect is consistent but small. Characteristicness also accounts for items the statistical factors get wrong: Canadians are right-handed has high prevalence, yet most larger models reject it, as people do, and nearly all models rate the property as not characteristic of Canadians. More generally, the baseline’s errors track characteristicness in most models for both types. The exception is Ryu et al.’s 20 IS_A items, where prevalence and cue validity already explain most of the variance and the factors are too closely related to separate (Appendix D.5 ).
blocks.zh: 特性提高了几乎每一种模型的可接受性,这两类模型都是通用的(图4)。 在基线最差的地方,其影响最大。 在隆等人的特征描述项目上,流行性和提示有效性几乎解释了大多数较大和推理模型的评级(差异的3-24 % , 相对于55 % ) , 但随着特征和惊人性,它们又解释了33-50 % 。 在康根岛上,效果一致但很小。 特征也指统计因素错误的项目: 加拿大人是右撇子,流行率很高,但大多数较大的模型都像人们一样拒绝,几乎所有模型都认为财产不是加拿大人的特征。 更一般地说,基线误差跟踪了大多数两种模型的特性。 Lyu等人的20个IS_A项目是例外,在这些项目中,普遍性和提示有效性已经解释了大多数差异,而且这些因素与单独项目的关系太密切(附录D.5)。

blocks.en: Strikingness, in contrast, adds little for either type of generic. Its weights are close to zero in most models, and where they are not, they mostly point the wrong way. This is not a failure of measurement, since every model recognises the striking generics as the most striking (Appendix D.4 ). The models know which properties are striking but do not treat strikingness as a reason to accept a generic, nor does it matter more for rare properties, as Leslie (2008) predicts (Appendix D.6 ). People may not either: Hermans et al. (2026) found that dangerousness affected how justifiable people found generics only at intermediate prevalence. On ConGen, most models find generics about striking properties less acceptable, but only because such properties are rare. They treat them like any other generic about a rare property.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,对于两种通用类型而言,强度几乎没有增加。 它的重量在大多数模型中接近于零,如果没有,它们大多指错方向. 这并不是衡量的失败,因为每个模型都承认引人注目的通用术语是最引人注目的(附录D.4)。 这些模型知道哪些属性是引人注目的,但并不把震撼性当作接受一个通用性的理由,对稀有属性来说也不重要,如Leslie(2008年)所预测(附录D.6). 人们不得: Hermans等人(2026年)发现,危险性影响人们仅在中等流行率时才发现通用术语。 在ConGen上,大多数模型发现关于击打属性的通用词不太可接受,但仅仅是因为这些属性是罕见的. 他们对待他们就像其他任何关于稀有财产的普通人一样.

blocks.en: Taken together, the two factors behave very differently. The models attend to characteristicness beyond prevalence and cue validity, most clearly in the larger and reasoning models, but they do not use strikingness. Yet even with both factors, much of the variance in the ratings remains unexplained, especially on ConGen’s natural generics. Next, we analyze the factors coming from the self-explanations of the models.
blocks.zh: 总之,这两个因素的表现非常不同。 这些模型处理的特征超出了普遍性和提示有效性,最明显的是较大的和推理模型,但它们并不使用惊人性。 然而,即使有这两个因素,评级方面的许多差异仍然无法解释,特别是在ConGen的自然通则方面。 接下来,我们分析模型自我解释中的各种因素。

blocks.en: 4.2 Factors from the models’ justification
blocks.zh: 4.2 模型理由的因素

blocks.en: Adding factuality to the four psychological factors has the largest weight in almost every model, for both types of generic and on both datasets, and together with overreach it raises the variance explained significantly in every model (Figure 4 ; all models in Appendix D.5 ). The gain is largest where the psychological factors explain least: on ConGen, factuality often doubles the variance explained. Factuality is not the same as acceptability, though. A statement can be true of most members of a kind and still make a poor generic, as with Humans are over three years old ( Leslie et al., 2011 ) , and the models make this distinction too: they reject up to a quarter of the statements they judge accurate, and on ConGen factuality alone often accounts for less than half of their acceptability ratings. Overreach plays a smaller role. Where it matters, it lowers acceptability, mainly on ConGen and in the larger models, and in several models it adds nothing once factuality is known.
blocks.zh: 在几乎每个模型中,增加四个心理因素的事实性对两种类型通用数据和两个数据集的权重都最大,加之它使每个模型中明显解释的差异增加(图4;附录D.5中的所有模型)。 在心理因素最不解释的情况下,收益最大:在ConGen上,事实往往使所解释的差异增加一倍。 但事实性与可接受性不同。 对大多数同类成员来说,一个声明可能是真实的,而且仍然做一个差的通称,就像人类已经超过3年了(Leslie等人,2011年)一样,模型也做出了这种区分:他们拒绝最多占自己判断准确的四分之一的言论,而仅ConGen actuality就往往占他们可接受评级的一半以下. 过度接触的作用较小。 无论在什么方面,它都降低了可接受性,主要是在ConGen和更大的模型中,在几个模型中,一旦了解了事实,它就没有任何增加.

blocks.en: However, factuality and overreach are not independent of the psychological factors. Prevalence, cue validity, characteristicness and strikingness explain a substantial part of the models’ factuality ratings: statements about properties that most members have, or that are characteristic of the kind, are judged more accurate and less overreaching in almost every model. As a result, almost everything the psychological factors explain about acceptability is also explained by factuality and overreach (Appendix D.7 ). The human factors thus still matter for the models, but they reach acceptability largely through judgments of whether a statement is true and whether it claims too much. On top of this shared part, factuality and overreach explain about as much again of their own. Appendix F discusses individual generics on which people and models depart from the statistical rule, and what the models’ factor ratings suggest about why.
blocks.zh: 然而,事实和过度接触并不独立于心理因素。 普遍程度、提示有效性、特征和引人注目性是模型事实评级的一大部分原因:在几乎所有模型中,对大多数成员拥有或具有这种特征的属性的描述都被认为更加准确和不太过分。 因此,几乎所有心理因素所解释的关于可接受性的问题,也都以事实性和过度普及性来解释(附录D.7). 因此,人的因素对于模型来说仍然重要,但主要通过判断一个陈述是否真实以及它是否要求过高而达到可接受的程度. 除了这个共同的部分之外, 事实和过度的普及 也再次解释了他们自己的问题。 附 录 F 讨论了个人通用术语和模型偏离统计规则的情况,以及模型要素评级对原因有何建议。

blocks.en: 4.3 Signal from probabilistic measures
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 来自概率措施的信号

blocks.en: Everything so far rests on what the models answer when asked. Previous NLP research showed that responses to prompts can understate what a model knows, and measures read directly from its probabilities are often more reliable ( Hu and Levy, 2023 ; Kauf et al., 2024 ) . We therefore also measured acceptability without asking a question: we gave each 7–9B model only the bare generic and read off how probable it finds the property given the kind, as the average log-probability of carry malaria after Mosquitoes ( Cilleruelo et al., 2025 , P-Acceptability;) . For generics, this signal agrees worse with the ratings of people than the models’ answers do, probably because the generics differ in every word, so their probabilities also reflect word frequency, word length, and how often such statements are written ( Kauf et al., 2024 ) . Still, with people’s prevalence and cue validity as predictors, it shows the same pattern as in Section 3 : IS_A generics become more probable with prevalence, feature-describing ones with cue validity, and the interaction points in the human direction in every model, though too weakly to be significant (Appendix D.8 ). Following Cilleruelo et al. (2025) , we also placed All , Most or Some before each generic and recorded which version makes the property most probable. This best-fitting quantifier tracks prevalence, with All for the most prevalent properties and Some for the least. Whether we ask the models or read their probabilities, both show which factors go together with acceptability, not which ones the model uses to reach it. We therefore look inside the models, testing whether moving their hidden states along each factor’s direction changes their judgment.
blocks.zh: 目前为止,一切都取决于模型在被问到时的答案。 先前的NLP研究表明,对提示的反应可以低估模型所知道的,直接从其概率中读取的措施往往更加可靠(Hu和Levy,2023;Kauf等人,2024)。 因此,我们还在不问任何问题的情况下衡量了可接受性:我们只给每个7-9B模型一个简单的通用性,并读出它如何可能发现这种财产,因为蚊虫之后携带疟疾的平均可能性(Cilleruelo等人,2025年,P-Acceptable;) 对于一般人来说,这个信号与人们的评分一致,比模型的答案更差,可能是因为一般人在每个词上都不同,所以它们的概率也反映了文字频率,字长,以及这种语句写作的频率(Kauf等人,2024年). 然而,随着人们的流行程度和作为预测器的提示有效性,它显示出了与第3节相同的模式:IS_A 类通则随着流行程度的提高而变得更加可能,特征描述则具有提示有效性,互动点则指向每个模型的人类方向,尽管过于微弱,不能成为重要的(附录D.8 )。 在Cilleruelo等人(2025年)之后,我们还将All, Most or Some部分放在每个通用文件之前,并记录了哪个版本使得财产最有可能。 这种最合适的限定符追踪到流行程度,其中最流行的特性为全部,而一些特性最少。 无论我们询问模型还是读取其概率,都显示哪些因素与可接受性相关,而不是模型用来达到的。 因此,我们审视模型内部,测试它们沿每个因素的方向移动隐藏状态是否改变它们的判断。

blocks.en: We examined the internal states of the six 7–9B models, adapting the method of El-Shangiti et al. (2025) . For each factor, we find a direction in the model’s hidden states and ask whether moving the hidden state along that direction changes the model’s acceptability judgment.
blocks.zh: 我们审查了六个7-9B模型的内部状态,对El-Shangiti等人(2025年)的方法进行了调整。 对于每个因素,我们发现模型隐藏状态的方向,并问沿着这个方向移动隐藏状态是否改变模型的可接受性判断.

blocks.en: 5.1 Method
blocks.zh: 5.1 方法

blocks.en: For each factor, we recorded the model’s hidden states while it read the question about that factor, for the feature-describing items in ConGen. At each layer, we identified the factor’s direction by regressing the hidden states on the model’s ratings of all six factors, so that each direction captures one factor with the others held constant. As ratings, we used the model’s expected rating, the average of the possible answers weighted by their probabilities, rather than the number it wrote, because expected ratings are continuous and read from the same input as the hidden states. Fitting to the written ratings gives essentially the same result (Appendix E.1 ), and the two kinds of rating agree closely, though not perfectly (Appendix E.2 ).
blocks.zh: 对于每个因素,我们记录了模型的隐藏状态,而它读了有关该因素的问题,用于ConGen中的特征描述项目。 在每一层,我们通过将模型对所有六个因素的评级中隐藏的状态递减来识别这个因素的方向,这样,每个方向就能捕捉一个因素与另一个因素保持恒定. 作为评分,我们使用了模型的预期评分,可能的答案的平均值按其概率加权,而不是它写的数字,因为预期的评分是连续的,从与隐藏状态相同的输入读取. 与书面收视率相匹配的结果基本相同(Appendix E.1 ),两种收视率虽然不完美(Appendix E.2 .

blocks.en: While the model reads the acceptability prompt, we added a factor’s direction to its hidden state at one layer, in doses of ± 0.5 \pm 0.5 and ± 1 \pm 1 times the typical distance of the states from their mean, and measured the change in its expected acceptability rating. A random direction pushed by the same amount served as a control. Interventions were run on 200 items per model, at layers between 40% and 85% of the model’s depth. We read and changed the hidden state at the last token of the question, before the instruction that specifies the answer format. Five of the factor questions share the acceptability scale, so where the model is about to answer, a factor’s direction partly encodes the number it will produce, and pushing along any such direction raises the rating regardless of what the factor means. Because models process text from left to right, the hidden state at the end of the question cannot contain information about the answer format.
blocks.zh: 虽然模型读取了可接受性的速率,但我们在一层增加了一个因子的方向,即剂量为± 0.5\pm 0.5和± 1\pm,是各州与平均值的典型距离的1倍,并测量了预期可接受性评级的变化。 由同样数量推动的随机方向作为控制。 每个模型有200个项目,其深度在40%至85%之间。 在指定答案格式的指令之前,我们在问题的最后符号上读取并修改了隐藏状态. 其中5个要素问题具有可接受性尺度,因此,当模型即将回答时,一个要素的方向部分地编码了它所产生的数字,而沿着任何这样的方向推进都会提高评级,无论该要素意味着什么。 因为模型从左到右处理文本,问题末尾的隐藏状态不能包含关于答案格式的信息.

blocks.en: Steering moves every item by the same, fixed amount. To test whether the differences that actually exist between items matter, we also swapped positions along each direction. Items in the bottom quarter of a factor’s ratings were given the position along its direction of a randomly chosen item from the top quarter, leaving the rest of the hidden state unchanged, and vice versa. We report the change in expected acceptability for the items moved up minus that for the items moved down, at the same layer and token as the steering.
blocks.zh: 引导移动每个项目 以相同的,固定的金额。 为了测试项目之间实际存在的差异是否重要,我们还沿每个方向互换位置。 一个因素评分的下季度的项目被赋予了沿其方向从上季度随机选择的项目的位置,其余隐藏状态保持不变,反之亦然. 我们报告项目预期可接受性的变化,减去项目预期可接受性的变化。

blocks.en: 5.2 Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果

blocks.en: Pushing along each factor’s direction changes the acceptability rating, in the direction the factor’s meaning predicts, and more than pushing along a random direction of the same size, in almost all cases by far (Table 1 ). Factuality has the largest positive effect in every model, tied with cue validity in Gemma. Prevalence, cue validity and characteristicness follow, in varying order, and strikingness, which plays almost no role in behavior, has a smaller but clear effect. Notably, cue validity, and in some models characteristicness, both of which carry little unique weight once factuality is in the behavioral model, change the judgment about as much as prevalence, so their small behavioral weights may reflect information shared with factuality rather than a lack of use. Overreach shows that the directions carry what a factor means rather than a tendency to give a higher number. Its question uses the same scale as acceptability, but a high value means that a statement claims too much, so a direction encoding only a higher answer would raise acceptability, whereas one encoding overreach should lower it. Pushing along it lowers acceptability in every model (Table 1 ), and giving items the position of overreaching ones lowers their rating in five of the six models (Appendix E.3 ).
blocks.zh: 推向每个因素的方向可以改变可接受性评分,按照因素的含义预测的方向,而且,在几乎所有情况下,都不只是推向同样大小的随机方向(表1)。 事实性在每个模型中都有最大的正面效果,与Gemma的提示有效性捆绑在一起. 普遍程度、提示有效性和特征依次不同,在行为中几乎不起作用的震撼性具有较小但明显的效果。 值得注意的是,提示有效性,以及一些模型中的特征,两者在行为模型中的事实性一旦发生,就没有什么独有的分量,会改变判断率和流行率一样多,因此其小的行为权重可能反映与事实性共享的信息,而不是缺乏使用. 超出范围表明,方向带有一个因素的含义,而不是给出较高数字的趋势。 其问题使用与可接受性相同的尺度,但高值意味着一个语句要求过高,所以只有更高答案的编码方向才会提高可接受性,而一个编码过宽应降低可接受性. 沿着这条路推进降低了每个模型的可接受性(表1),使项目具有影响过大者的地位,降低了它们在六个模型中的五个模型的评级(附录E.3)。

blocks.en: Swapping the positions of items along a factor’s direction shows which of these differences matter at the size they actually take (Appendix E.3 ). Giving items the position of items rated more factual raises their rating by up to 1.8 points in five of the six models, and the corresponding swaps raise it for prevalence and cue validity in every model and lower it for overreach in five of the six. Swaps along strikingness shift it only slightly, by at most .07 points, and swaps along the random direction leave it unchanged. At realistic sizes, factuality thus matters most and strikingness barely at all, in line with their roles in behavior, while strikingness has a clear effect only when pushed far beyond the differences between items.
blocks.zh: 沿一个因素的方向移动各项目的位置,表明这些差异中哪些按其实际大小重要(附录E.3)。 给予项目被评为更符合事实的项目的地位,在六个模型中的五个模型中,其评分最高可达1.8分,相应的互换则提高每个模型中的普遍性和提示有效性,并在六个模型中的五个模型中降低超标率。 随震动方向的换乘仅略微改变,最多为0.07点,随随机方向的换乘使其不变. 因此,在现实的大小上,事实性最重要,而且与它们在行为中的角色几乎毫不相干,而惊人性只有在远远超出项目之间的差异时才会产生明显的效果。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and future work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: Psycholinguistic factors explain part of how LLMs judge generics. The models combine prevalence and cue validity as the human rule predicts, though less clearly, and favor characteristic properties but, not striking ones. Above all, they judge whether a generic is true, and the human factors shape their judgments largely through that. Inside the models, each factor has a direction that moves the judgment as its meaning predicts. Although the factors explain much of how LLMs judge generics, a large share of the variance still remains unexplained.
blocks.zh: 心理语言学因素解释了部分LLMs如何判断一般人. 这些模型结合了流行性和提示有效性,如人类规则所预测的,尽管不太明确,而且偏爱特征性,但并不引人注目。 最重要的是,他们判断一个通用词是否正确,而人的因素主要通过这个来决定他们的判断。 在模型内部,每个因子都有一个方向,可以移动判断作为意义预测. 虽然这些因素在很大程度上解释了有限责任公司如何判断一般人,但很大一部分差异仍然没有得到解释。

blocks.en: Future work should identify the factors behind the unexplained variance, especially for naturally occurring generics, and collect human acceptability ratings for them so that models and people can be compared on more items. It should also trace how models combine factors beyond single directions and test generics in context, in other languages, and about social groups, where overgeneralizing may cause the most harm ( Peters and Quintana, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应查明造成这种无法解释的差异的因素,特别是自然出现的普通字,并收集人们对其的可接受性评级,以便可以比较更多项目上的模型和人。 它还应该追踪模型如何结合单一方向以外的因素,在上下文中,在其他语言中,以及有关社会群体中,过度概括可能造成最大伤害(Peters and Quintana, 2024).

blocks.en: Appendix B Constructing the ConGen items
blocks.zh: 附录B 构建康金项目

blocks.en: We parsed each sentence with spaCy ( Honnibal et al., 2020 ) and extracted the subtree rooted at the main verb’s nominal subject as the category phrase. The head noun was singularised and given an indefinite article (“Millipedes” → \rightarrow “a millipede”), except for nouns identified as uncountable, such as “furniture.” A noun was treated as uncountable if its singular and plural forms were identical or if its plural was much less frequent than its singular in a word-frequency list ( Speer, 2022 ) . The remaining clause formed the property phrase, with the verb inflected for a third-person singular subject (“eat” → \rightarrow “eats”; “do not grow” → \rightarrow “does not grow”). Following Ryu et al. (2022) , we labelled items as IS_A when the root was a copula with a noun phrase complement (“Joshua trees are desert plants”), and as feature-describing otherwise.
blocks.zh: 我们用温泉分析每一句 Cy (Honnibal et al., 2020) 并提取了根植于主动词名义主体的亚树作为分类短语. 头名词被单词化,并赠送了一条无限期的文章(“Millipedes”) ——\\\右旋“一个毫ipede”),但被确定为不可计算的名词除外,如“家具”。 如果一个名词的单数和复数形式相同,或者其复数在单数频率列表中比其单数频繁得多(Speer, 2022),则该名词被视为不可计算. 其余条款构成属性短语,动词为第三人称单数主体(“吃”) =\右侧“吃” ;“不生长” =\右侧“不生长” 。 继Lyu等人(2022年)之后,我们把物品标为IS_ A 根是带有名词短语补充的复古词(“乔斯华树是沙漠植物”),并作为特征描述。

blocks.en: A sentence was rejected only if no item could be built from it: its subject was a singular proper noun, which refers to an individual rather than a kind; it had no identifiable subject; its property phrase became empty after repair; its subject was a countable singular noun, which does not express a generic; or its subject was not a noun. Otherwise, sentences were repaired where needed. This produced 868 items, 120 of which had been repaired.
blocks.zh: 只有在无法从中构建物品的情况下,才拒绝一个句子:其主体是一个单数的正名词,指个人而不是一类;它没有可识别的主体;其财产短语在修复后变得空洞;其主体是一个可计数的单数名词,不表示通用;或其主体不是名词. 否则,判决将按需要予以修正。 这共生产了868件物品,其中120件已经修复。

blocks.en: We used WordNet ( Miller, 1992 ) to identify a comparison category for each item. To select the sense of the category noun, we embedded the generic and its phrases, along with each candidate sense’s gloss, using all-MiniLM-L6-v2 , a Sentence-Transformers model ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) based on MiniLM ( Wang et al., 2020 ) . We selected the sense with the highest cosine similarity only if it exceeded the similarity of the most frequent sense by more than 0.20; otherwise, we retained the most frequent sense. We then searched all hypernym paths from the selected sense for the nearest ancestor meeting two criteria. First, it needed a SemCor ( Miller et al., 1993 ) sense frequency of at least 5, to favour familiar categories over technical terms such as “anseriform bird.” Second, it needed at least 100 descendant synsets, to exclude categories that were too narrow, such as “educator” for “teacher.” Candidates were ranked by distance and then by SemCor frequency. For IS_A generics, the comparison category also had to be strictly broader than the category named in the property phrase.
blocks.zh: 我们利用WordNet(米勒,1992年)为每个项目确定一个比较类别. 为了选择类名词的感官,我们嵌入了泛义及其短语,连同每个候选感官的光泽,使用All-MiniLM-L6-v2,一个基于MiniLM(Wang等人,2020年)的句子转换模型(Reimers and Gurevich, 2019年). 我们选择的感官,只有超过最常感的相似度0.20以上;否则,我们保留了最常感. 然后,我们从所选择的感官中搜索了所有超名路径,以寻找符合两个标准的最近的祖先。 首先,它需要至少5个感官频率的SemCor(Miller等人,1993年),以偏爱熟悉的类别,而不是诸如“典型鸟类”之类的技术术语。 其次,至少需要100种后裔的组合,以排除过于狭隘的类别,如“教师”的“教育者”。 考生按距离排名,然后按SemCor频率排名. 对于IS_A类类,比较类还必须严格比属性短语中命名的类要宽.

blocks.en: An LLM judge (Gemini 2.5 Pro ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) ) assessed whether each generated prevalence question preserved the meaning of the original sentence. It received the original sentence and the generated question, and returned a verdict and an error category, without being told whether the item had been repaired. The authors reviewed the 253 flagged items, correcting category or property phrases, shortening sentences or removing items. This left 766 items.
blocks.zh: 一名LLM法官(Gemini 2.5 Pro(Comanici等人,2025年))评估了每个生成的流行性问题是否保留了原句的含义. 它收到了原句和产生的问题,并退回了判决和错误类别,没有被告知物品是否已经修复。 提交人审查了253个标有标记的物品,更正了类别或属性短语,缩短了句子或删除了物品。 这留下了766件物品。

blocks.en: The same judge assessed whether each comparison category captured the alternatives people would consider for the target kind, following Ryu et al. (2022) , for example, “a toy” for “Dolls wear dresses.” It approved 209 categories. Two annotators independently reviewed the remaining 557, either retaining the proposed category, suggesting an alternative or requesting that the item be removed. The annotators agreed on 394 items. A third annotator resolved disagreements by choosing between options presented anonymously and in random order, without being told that they arose from a disagreement. The final dataset contained 732 items.
blocks.zh: 同一位法官评估了是否每个比较类别都包含人们会考虑针对目标类型的替代物,仅次于Ryu等人(2022年),例如“娃娃穿礼服”的“玩具”。 它批准了209个类别。 两名书记员独立审查了其余的557个,要么保留拟议类别,提出一个替代办法,要么要求删除该项目。 注释者就394个项目达成协议。 第三个注释员解决了分歧,在匿名和随机提出的选择之间作出选择,而没有被告知这些选择是由分歧引起的。 最后数据集包含732项.

blocks.en: Table 3 shows how closely each model’s ratings, and its group’s averaged ratings, track the human means on Ryu et al.’s feature-describing generics. The group averages correlate with human prevalence at r = .79 r=.79 – .87 .87 and with human cue validity at r = .73 r=.73 – .75 .75 , matching or exceeding the best single model in each group in all but one case. This is why, on ConGen, where human ratings are unavailable, we also test the interaction with group-averaged prevalence and cue validity (§ 3.4 ).

blocks.en: Table 5 reports the interaction for every model under each analysis described in § 3.4 . Taken together, the estimates show a consistent direction. Of the 48 estimates obtained with linear models (twelve models under four analyses), 43 are negative, in the direction of the human interaction, and 14 are significantly so; none is significantly positive. The models therefore do not combine prevalence and cue validity in the opposite way to humans; they differ in how clearly they show the human pattern.
blocks.zh: 表5报告了第3.4节所述每项分析下的每个模型的相互作用。 总起来看,这些估计表明方向一致。 在通过线性模型获得的48个估计数(4个分析下的12个模型)中,43个是负数,指人类相互作用的方向,14个是显著的;没有1个是显著的正数。 因此,这些模型并没有以相反的方式将流行性和暗示有效性与人类结合起来;它们如何清晰地显示人类模式则有所不同。

blocks.en: The same consistency appears in the shape of the relationship (Figure 5 ). For each model and analysis, we fitted acceptability against prevalence separately for properties with high and low cue validity. With the human ratings of prevalence and cue validity, and with the ratings averaged over each group of models, the advantage of a high cue validity is largest at low prevalence and smallest at high prevalence (negative interaction) for all twelve models, though not always significant. Against the human ratings, the interaction is negative for every model, as for humans, although it is weaker than in humans for most models, and significant only for the two models where it is stronger (Llama-3.1-70B and Gemini-3.8-Flash). With the models’ own ratings the same shape appears in a flatter form; it is nearly flat for Mistral-7B on ConGen and Gemini-3.8-Flash on Ryu et al.’s items, and reversed only for Llama-3.1-8B on Ryu et al.’s items.
blocks.zh: 同样的一致性也出现在关系形状上(图5). 对于每一种模式和分析,我们分别将可接受性与高和低提示性特性的可接受性相区别。 随着人类对流行率和提示有效性的评级,以及每组模型的平均评级,在所有12个模型中,高提示有效性的优势在低流行率时最大,在高流行率时最小(负相互作用),尽管并不总是重要的。 与人类的评分相比,互动对每个模型都是负面的,与人类一样,虽然对大多数模型来说,互动比人类的更弱,并且只对两个更强的模型(Llama-3.1-70B和双子座-3.8-Flash)具有显著意义. 随着模型本身的收视率,同样的形状以优美的形式出现;在ConGen和双子座-3.8-Flash上对Mistral-7B的收视率接近平,在隆等人的收视率上仅对Llama-3.1-8B的收视率反转.

blocks.en: Whether an individual model shows a significant interaction depends on the data and on the noise in its ratings. On Ryu et al.’s 64 feature-describing items, few models reach significance, and which ones do is unrelated to which do so on ConGen: the models’ estimates on the two datasets are uncorrelated. The small item set offers too little power to rank models, which is why ConGen provides the more informative test. Noise in the models’ own ratings matters mainly for the smaller models. Averaging prevalence and cue validity within each group strengthens the interaction for five of the six 7–9B models, and makes it significant for three, but leaves the larger models largely unchanged. The judgments of the smaller models may thus already reflect the interaction, but their own answers about the two factors are too noisy to reveal it, whereas the larger models’ answers are consistent enough with their judgments for the interaction to appear without averaging.
blocks.zh: 单个模型是否显示显著的相互作用取决于数据及其评级中的噪音. 在Ryu等人的64个特征描述项目上,很少有模型具有意义,哪些模型与ConGen无关:这两个数据集上的模型估计是无关的。 小项集提供的权力太少,无法对模型进行排位,这也是ConGen提供更丰富的测试的原因. 这些模型本身的评级中的噪声主要对较小的模型有影响。 每个群体内部的反射普及性和提示有效性加强了6个7-9B模型中的5个模型的互动,使3个模型变得重要,但较大模型基本上保持不变。 因此,较小模型的判断可能已经反映了相互作用,但是它们自己对两个因素的答案太吵,无法揭示,而较大的模型的答案与其判断一致,以至于相互作用出现而不平均。

blocks.en: D.1 What the models’ explanations distinguish
blocks.zh: D.1 联合国 模型解释的不同之处

blocks.en: Each 7–9B model rated Ryu et al.’s 84 items after first explaining its reasoning under three chain-of-thought prompts, which gave 1,510 explanations with a valid rating. To see what the models attend to without deciding in advance what to look for, we split the explanations by the rating they ended in, rejection (rating ≤ 0 \leq 0 ) or acceptance ( ≥ 2 \geq 2 ), and asked which words are much more common in one group. We counted every word and two-word phrase, after removing the final answer line, the words of the generic itself, common function words, and words used in fewer than 15 explanations. We scored each by its weighted log-odds ratio with an informative prior ( Monroe et al., 2008 ) , which measures how reliably it distinguishes the two groups.
blocks.zh: 每个7–9B模型在首先根据三个思维链提示解释其推理后,将Ryu等人的84件物品评为合格,给出了1,510件解释。 为了在不事先决定要寻找什么的情况下看这些模型要处理什么,我们用它们最后的评分,拒绝(评分为0\leq 0)或接受(≥2\geq 2)来划分解释,并询问在一个组中哪些词更为常见. 我们计算了每一个字和两个字的短语,在删除了最后的回答行,通用本身的词,共同的功能词,以及不到15个解释中使用的词. 我们用其加权对数比来评分,并事先提供了资料(Monroe等人,2008年),衡量它如何可靠地区分这两个组别。

blocks.en: Table 6 lists the most distinctive words. Rejections are marked by two kinds of objection: that the statement overgeneralises ( not, all, implies all, generalization, broad, misleading ) and that it is factually wrong ( incorrect, inaccurate, not accurate ). Acceptances are marked by the statement being factually correct ( correct, accurately, fact, known, widely accepted ) and clearly worded ( grammatically correct, clear ), and, less strongly, by the property being common or characteristic .

blocks.en: Table 7 compares three baselines within each type of generic by how well they predict held-out items (10-fold cross-validated R 2 R^{2} , mean of five splits): prevalence alone, prevalence and cue validity, and Ryu et al.’s rule with their interaction.

blocks.en: For IS_A generics, prevalence and cue validity are the best or tied-best baseline in 9 of 12 models on both datasets. On Ryu et al.’s items cue validity takes a negative weight in every model, as it does for people, whose ratings it also predicts better (.71 vs. .82): inverses such as Mammals are dogs are highly diagnostic but rarely true. Ryu et al. describe IS_A acceptability as following prevalence alone, on the basis of each factor’s correlation with acceptability, but did not fit the two together.

blocks.en: D.3 Characteristicness and strikingness against prevalence
blocks.zh: D.3 与流行率相比的特点和显著性

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows how each model’s characteristicness and strikingness ratings relate to its prevalence ratings. Characteristicness rises with prevalence in every model and dataset ( r = .24 r=.24 – .63 .63 ). This is expected as a principled connection between a kind and a property leads one to expect most members to have it, though a common property need not be a principled one ( Prasada et al., 2013 ) . Strikingness falls with prevalence in all but one case ( r r down to − .54 -.54 ; the exception is Llama-3.1-8B on ConGen), since striking properties are typically had by few members of a kind ( Leslie, 2008 ) . The figure also shows a difference between the groups as the 7–9B models rate most generics as mildly striking whatever their prevalence, whereas the larger and reasoning models rate common properties as clearly unremarkable.

blocks.en: D.4 Validation of characteristicness and strikingness
blocks.zh: D.4 特征和震撼性的验证

blocks.en:
Ryu et al.’s 84 items are the materials of Prasada et al. (2013) , who sorted them into
seven types of twelve items each. Their account predicts which types involve a principled connection between kind and property, and so should be rated characteristic: quasi-definitions ( Ants are insects ) and majority and minority characteristic generics
( Tigers are striped , Ducks lay eggs ). The other four types should not be: majority statistical generics ( Cars have radios ), striking generics ( Mosquitoes carry malaria ),
and majority and minority false generalisations ( Canadians are right-handed , Rooms are round ). Table 8 tests each model’s ratings against these predictions. All twelve models rate the three principled types as more characteristic than the other four, and for nine of them the ranking of the seven types follows people’s ratings of principled connections in Prasada et al.’s study.
blocks.zh:
隆等人的84件物品是普拉萨达等人(2013年)的材料,他们将其分类为:
七类各十二品. 他们的叙述预测哪些类型涉及种类与财产之间的原则性联系,因此应该被评为特征:准定义(蚂蚁是昆虫)以及多数和少数特征的通用性
(老虎是条纹的,鸭子产卵). 其他四种类型不应是:大多数统计学类(汽车有收音机),打击学类(蚊子携带疟疾),
以及多数和少数派的虚假概括(加拿大人是右撇子, 表8对照这些预测来检验每个模型的评级。 所有十二种模式都认为这三种原则类型比其他四种更具有特征,对其中九种模式来说,这七种模式的排名遵循普拉萨达等人的研究中对原则联系的人的评级。

blocks.en: The hardest case contrasts minority characteristic generics such as Ducks lay eggs with majority statistical ones such as Cars have radios . Elsewhere, characteristic properties are also the more common ones, so a model could pass by tracking prevalence; here prevalence points the other way, as people judge the former less common, so a model relying on prevalence would rate them lower. We therefore also compare the two types while controlling for each model’s own prevalence ratings. Seven of the twelve models rate minority characteristic generics as more characteristic even then. In the other five the difference is not significant: it is near zero or reverses for OLMo-3-7B, Gemma-2-9B and the two Llama models, and is positive but not significant for Gemini-2.5-Flash ( p = .055 p=.055 ). For Llama-3.1-8B, the raw difference disappears once prevalence is controlled, so its characteristicness ratings partly re-express its prevalence estimates. Several of these models also rate striking properties as characteristic, which Prasada et al. (2013) do not count as principled. With twelve items per type, these tests have limited power, but they suggest that the characteristicness weights in Section 4 are most trustworthy for the seven models that pass.
blocks.zh: 与小鸭子产卵等少数特征类相比, 在其他地方,特征性也是比较常见的特征,因此一个模型可以通过跟踪流行性而通过;这里流行性指向了另一种方式,因为人们判断前者不太常见,因此依赖流行性的模型会让他们得到较低的评价. 因此,我们还比较这两种类型,同时控制每个模型本身的流行率。 在十二种模型中,有七种将少数特征的通用性评为更典型的,甚至当时. 在另外5种情况下,差异并不显著:对于OLMo-3-7B,Gemma-2-9B和两种Llama模型来说,差异接近0或反差,对于双子座-2.5-Flash(p=.055 p=.055)来说是正但并不显著. 对于Llama-3.1-8B来说,原始差异一旦流行得到控制就消失,因此其特征评级部分地重新表述了其流行估计. 其中一些模型还把震撼性能评为特征,普拉萨达等人(2013年)不认为是原则性特征。 由于每型有十二件物品,这些测试的功率有限,但是它们表明第4节中的特征重量对于通过的七个模型来说是最值得信赖的.

blocks.en: Table 9 adds characteristicness and strikingness to the baseline, and Table 10 adds factuality and overreach to all four psychological factors, for feature-describing generics on both datasets and IS_A generics on ConGen. Together they give, for every model, the variance explained at each step summarised in Figure 4 . Characteristicness raises acceptability in most models (eleven of twelve on Ryu et al.’s feature-describing items, nine on ConGen’s, eleven on ConGen’s IS_A items), while strikingness is mostly near zero and, where significant, more often negative. Factuality has a significant positive weight in every model and dataset; overreach, where significant, mostly lowers acceptability. Most of what the four psychological factors explain in acceptability is also explained by factuality and overreach.

blocks.en: D.6 Interactions of the psychological factors
blocks.zh: D.6 心理因素的相互作用

blocks.en: The psychological accounts predict two interactions with prevalence. Leslie (2008) proposes that a striking property licenses a generic even when it is rare, so strikingness should matter more at low prevalence (a negative prevalence × \times strikingness weight). A characteristic property may likewise compensate for low prevalence, as in Ducks lay eggs (a negative prevalence × \times characteristicness weight). To test them, we add each interaction, one at a time, to the four-factor regression of Table 9 and report its weight in Table 11 , together with the change in held-out R 2 R^{2} when all pairwise interactions are added at once.
blocks.zh: 心理分析预测了两种与流行的相互作用。 Leslie (2008年)建议,即使低流行率(负流行率×时的惊人重量)是罕见的普通财产许可证,那么惊人程度应更重要。 特征属性同样可以弥补低流行率,如鸭子产卵(负流行率××时态特征重量). 为了检验它们,我们将每个相互作用,一次一个地加到表9的四因子回归中,并在表11中报告其重量,同时当所有对偶相互作用同时增加时,还报告被搁置的R 2 R^{2}的变化。

blocks.en: Neither prediction holds reliably. No model shows the first: where the prevalence × \times strikingness weight is significant, it is positive. The second appears in three models for feature-describing generics on ConGen, with small weights, and in the opposite direction in two on Ryu et al.’s items. Adding all pairwise interactions among the factors at once makes the predictions for held-out items worse in 11 of 12 models for feature-describing generics on both datasets and in all 12 for IS_A generics on ConGen. We therefore report the additive models.

blocks.en:
For the six 7–9B models, whose token probabilities are available, we computed two measures of
acceptability that involve no question. P-Acceptability is the negative cross-entropy of the property
tokens given the subject, so that a property the model finds predictable for the kind scores high ( Cilleruelo et al., 2025 ) . SLOR is the log-probability of the whole sentence, normalised
for the frequency of its words and its length ( Lau et al., 2017 ) . On Ryu et al.’s items, P-Acceptability correlates with people’s acceptability at r = .39 r=.39 – .46 .46 and SLOR at .29 .29 – .43 .43 , both below the models’ answers ( r = .51 r=.51 – .84 .84 ; Table 12 ).

significant in none. The human pattern thus appears not only in what the models answer but in how probable they find the generic itself: its main effects are clearly present, while the interaction, as with the written ratings, points the right way but is too weak to establish for individual models.

blocks.en:
Following Cilleruelo et al. (2025) , we compared each generic with

All is the most frequent best fit for every model (37–71% of Ryu et al.’s items, 30–42% of ConGen’s), Some accounts for 19–27% of ConGen’s, close to the fifth that Cilleruelo et al. (2025) report, and the bare plural fits best for only 2–24%. We also find that the best-fitting quantifier tracks prevalence (Figure 8 ): in every model and dataset except OLMo on Ryu et al.’s items, the generics best fitted by All have the highest prevalence and those best fitted by Some the lowest (people’s prevalence on Ryu et al.’s items, the model’s own on ConGen).

blocks.en: E.1 Results with the written ratings

blocks.en: In the main analysis, each factor’s direction is fitted to the model’s expected rating of the factor, the average of the possible answers weighted by their probabilities. Fitting the directions to the ratings the models actually wrote instead gives the same results. Across all layers and directions, the steering effects of the two versions correlate at r = .993 r=.993 – .998 .998 for every model, and the layer at which factuality’s effect peaks is the same in all six (Table 13 ).
blocks.zh: 在主要分析中,每个因素的方向都与模型对因素的预期评级相符,即可能答案的平均值,按其概率加权。 与收视率的方向相匹配 模型实际写出的结果是一样的。 在所有的层次和方向上,两种版本的转向效应在r = 993 r = 993 – 998 – 998 – 每一种模型中都有关联,而事实效果峰值在所有六个模型中都相同的层次(表13).

blocks.en: E.2 What the models write and what their probabilities say
blocks.zh: (单位:千美元) 模特儿写了什么 她们的概率怎么说

blocks.en: A model’s written rating need not be the answer its output probabilities favor, so we compared the two for every question (Table 14 ). For each of ConGen’s feature-describing generics, the expected rating is the average of the possible answers weighted by their probabilities when the model is about to answer, and the most probable answer is the single answer with the highest probability; the written rating comes from greedy generation at temperature 0.
blocks.zh: 一个模型的书面评级不一定是它的输出概率偏好,所以我们每个问题都比较这两个(表14). 对于每个ConGen的特征描述通用词,预期的评分是模型即将回答时根据其概率加权的可能答案的平均值,最可能的答案是概率最高的单一答案;书面评分来自0温度时的贪婪一代.

blocks.en: The two agree closely but not perfectly. The written rating correlates with the expected rating at r = .77 r=.77 – .99 .99 , depending on model and question, and nearly all probability falls on valid answers for every model and question. Agreement differs more between models than between questions: Qwen3-8B writes its most probable answer for 95–99% of items ( r = .97 r=.97 – .99 .99 ), whereas OLMo does so for as few as 58% ( r = .77 r=.77 – .91 .91 ). Among the questions, overreach shows the least agreement ( r = .77 r=.77 – .97 .97 ).
blocks.zh: 两者意见非常一致,但并非完全一致。 书面评级与预期的评级(r=.77 r=.77 –.99)相关,视模型和问题而定,几乎所有概率都取决于每个模型和问题的有效答案. 不同模式之间的协议比问题之间的协议更不同:Qune3-8B为95-99 % 的项目(r = 97 r = 97 – 99 ) 写出最有可能的答案,而OLMo的答案却只有58%(r = 77 r = 77 – 91 ) 。 在这些问题中,超广显示的共识最少(r=.77 r=.77 –.97.

blocks.en: Even with greedy decoding, a written rating can differ from the most probable answer for technical reasons: a number is written token by token, so the first token chosen need not begin the most probable number (as for prevalence, from 0 to 100), and the prompts of the written runs and of the scoring differ slightly in tokenization for some models. The disagreement is therefore an upper bound on how far what a model writes departs from what it encodes about the answer. In line with Hu and Levy (2023) , it suggests that written ratings are a close but imperfect window on a model’s own judgment, which is why the main analysis uses the expected ratings; as Appendix E.1 shows, the conclusions do not depend on the choice.
blocks.zh: 即使有贪婪的解码,由于技术原因,书面的评分也可以与最可能的答复不同:一个数字是按符记写的,所以所选的第一个符号不需要开始最可能的数字(如流行的,从0到100),对于一些模型来说,书面的运行和评分的提示在标分上略有不同. 因此,在模型的写作与它编码的答案相去多远的问题上,分歧是一个上限。 与Hu和Levy(2023年)一致,它提出书面收视率在模型自身判断上是一个近但不完美的窗口,这就是主要分析使用预期收视率的原因;正如附录E.1所示,结论并不取决于选择.

Factuality gives the largest shift in five of the six models, up to 1.79 points; in Gemma it is not distinguishable from zero. blocks.en: Appendix F Where people and models depart from the rule
blocks.zh: 附录F 人员和模式偏离规则的情况

blocks.en: For each of the 64 feature-describing items, we compared people’s and each model’s acceptability rating with what Ryu et al. ’s rule predicts from their own prevalence and cue-validity ratings. The items the rule gets wrong are mostly the same for people and models, and the models’ ratings of the other factors suggest why. Both reject human-related generalizations, such as Engineers are male and Teachers are female , more than the rule predicts. Ryu et al. (2022) suggested that people may know more counterexamples about human beings and avoid generalizations that create stereotypes, and the models show this tendency in a sharper form: they agree with people that most engineers are male, yet judge the statement inaccurate and overreaching, treating a common stereotype as a false claim about the group; on average, all twelve reject Ryu et al.’s generalizations about human beings more than the rule predicts. In the other direction, people and models both accept generics such as Car crashes kill people and Ducks lay eggs more than the rule predicts, and all twelve models rate these as fully accurate, consistent with their judgments following truth rather than frequency. The models are stricter than people with generics whose counterinstances have an alternative property, which Leslie (2008) argues are judged false because they take on an almost universal reading: people are nearly neutral about Ducks are female and Lions are male , while almost every model rejects both and rates them as inaccurate, as Leslie’s account predicts. The smaller models diverge further on generics about harm: they reject Plastic bags suffocate small children and Rip tides drown swimmers , which people and most of the larger models accept, and five of the six reject Knives cut people although all six rate it as accurate. Factuality cannot explain this last rejection; it may reflect safety tuning that makes smaller models reluctant to endorse unqualified statements about harm to people, although they accept others, such as Car crashes kill people , so the boundary is not clear-cut. Finally, almost every model accepts Tables are 10 feet long , although half of them rate it as inaccurate; here the models may judge whether the sentence is well formed rather than whether it is true, a reading their explanations sometimes adopt.
blocks.zh: 对于64个特写项目,我们把人们和每个模型的可接受性与隆等人的可接受性进行了比较。 其规则预示着他们自己的流行程度和素率。 规则被错误的项目对人和模型来说大多是一样的,模型对其他因素的评级表明了原因. 两者都拒绝与人类有关的概括,例如工程师是男性,教师是女性,比规则预测的要多。 龙等. (2022年)暗示人们可能更了解人类的反例,避免产生成见的概括性,模型以更尖锐的形式显示出这一趋势:他们与人们一样认为大多数工程师是男性,然而判断这一说法不准确和过分,把共同的陈规定型当作对人群的虚假主张;平均来说,所有十二人都否定隆等人对人类的概括性,比规则预测的要多. 在另一个方向上,人们和模型都接受诸如车祸杀人,鸭子产卵比规则预言的多的通称,所有12个模型都认为这些是完全准确的,符合他们遵循真理而不是频率的判断. 这些模型比一般人更严格,他们反间谍有另一种属性,Leslie (2008年)认为这种属性是虚假的,因为他们几乎是普遍阅读的:人们对鸭子是女性和狮子是男性几乎持中立态度,而几乎每个模型都拒绝两者并评价其不准确,正如Leslie的账户所预测的那样。 更小的模型在一般的伤害上进一步分歧:他们拒绝塑料袋窒息的小孩, Rip潮水淹死游泳者, 事实无法解释这最后的拒绝;它可能反映安全调试,使得较小的模型不愿认可关于伤害人的无条件声明,尽管它们接受其他人,如车祸杀人,因此边界并不清晰. 最后,几乎每个模型都接受表的长度为10英尺,尽管其中一半认为表的长度不准确;在此,模型可以判断句子的形成是否良好,而不是是否属实,阅读他们的解释有时会被采纳.
